title: Query Optimization

sections.content: Fast queries: filter early (WHERE on indexed columns), select only needed columns, avoid SELECT *, prefer JOINs over correlated subqueries, and paginate with LIMIT.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows the execution plan — seq scans on big tables signal missing indexes; nested loops on big joins signal bad plans.
Key points: measure before optimizing, index selective columns, avoid functions on indexed columns in WHERE (kills index use), and cache expensive aggregates.

sections.codeExample:
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42;
